service.name: scenario-to-plugin
service.description: Deployment ramp that packages, signs, and publishes a Vrooli scenario as an Agent Plugin — Agent Skills plus MCP servers — to agent runtimes and skill registries

setup.description: Build API and UI assets declared by the manifest-driven lifecycle contract

steps.name: build-api
steps.run: cd api && GOWORK=off go mod download && GOWORK=off go build -o scenario-to-plugin-api .

steps.name: install-ui-deps
steps.run: if [ -f ui/package.json ]; then cd ui && (corepack pnpm install --ignore-workspace || pnpm install --ignore-workspace); else echo 'ui/ not present yet'; fi

steps.name: build-ui
steps.run: if [ -f ui/package.json ]; then cd ui && (corepack pnpm --ignore-workspace run build || pnpm --ignore-workspace run build); else echo 'ui/ not present yet'; fi

develop.description: Launch API and Vite dev server

steps.name: start-api
steps.description: Start Go API server in background

test.description: Execute phased test suite via test-genie

steps.name: check-temporal-models
steps.description: Verify formal flow artifacts via the flow-verifier scenario CLI

steps.name: run-tests
steps.description: Run all test phases via test-genie

deployment-manager.description: Governance plane: release-gate decisions and TargetVerdict ingest.
deployment-manager.degraded_behavior: Composition, conformance, attestation, and rehearsal remain available; publication and revocation are refused until deployment-manager is healthy, because no release decision can be obtained.

workspace-sandbox.degraded_behavior: Packages can be composed, checked, and attested; rehearsal is refused rather than run unisolated, so no package can reach publication.

cli-health.description: Pinned command-surface source for the skill-to-CLI drift check.
cli-health.degraded_behavior: The drift gate fails closed rather than passing unchecked; composition and readiness remain available.

secrets-manager.description: Registry and signing credential references resolved at publish time.
secrets-manager.degraded_behavior: The full pipeline runs up to publication; channel calls that need a credential reference are refused with the missing reference named.

scenario-dependency-analyzer.description: Governed third-party package installation and SBOM dependency facts.
scenario-dependency-analyzer.degraded_behavior: Runtime is unaffected; SBOM generation falls back to direct manifest inspection and records reduced dependency provenance.

offer-desk.description: Receives per-plugin channel evidence for the skill-registries channel.
offer-desk.degraded_behavior: Attribution is recorded locally and forwarded when Offer Desk returns; no pipeline stage blocks.

knowledge-observatory.description: Indexes published skill documentation for fleet-wide search.
knowledge-observatory.degraded_behavior: Published packages are unaffected; indexing is deferred until the service returns.
